title: Scheme under paragraph 12-A M L R 118 1972 Private Management Schools or Colleges Taking Over Amendment Order 1983

sections.shortTitle: Scheme under paragraph 12-A M L R 118 1972 Private Management Schools or Colleges Taking Over Amendment Order 1983
sections.description:
SCHEME UNDER PARAGRAPH 12-A, MLR 118, 1972 PRIVATE
SCHEME UNDER PARAGRAPH 12‑A MLR 118, 1972
PRIVATE
MANAGEMENT
SCHOOLS/COLLEGES (TAKING OVER)
AMENDMENT
ORDER, 1983
[Gazette
of Punjab, Part I,
19th
January, 2000]
No.S.O.(R&B)
1‑18/90‑A.III, dated 17‑8‑1999.
1. SALIENT
FEATURES:
The Scheme
comprises the following features:‑‑
(a) Terms and Conditions of service of Teachers working in
Nationalized Institutions.
(b) Building/Assets of Nationalized schools.
(c)‑Student affairs.
2. TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF
SERVICE OF TEACHERS WORKING IN NATIONALIZED INSTITUTIONS:
(a) Salaries
of the Teaching/non‑teaching, staff.‑‑The staff of these institutions shall continue to be Government
servants and shall draw their pay against the same posts till they are adjusted
in other schools. They
however will
have an option to stay on with the new management if both parties agree to such
an agreement, in which case conditions in para.2(c) will apply.
(b) Terms and
conditions of nay.‑‑---The Government
will continue to pay salary and allowances to those employees who opt to remain
'in Government service at the rate as admissible to them.
(c) Option
for the Teaching staff.‑‑--The staff of
the institutions privatized shall be allowed to exercise option following
privatization for continuation in the Government service or that of Private
Management.
(d) Medical
Facilities.‑‑--The employees will
continue to enjoy the medical facilities as in Government service, who opt for
Government service.
(e) Pension.‑‑--The Government will transfer all accumulated benefits of pension,
levy and other entitlement in case of those staff who have served in Government
for more than ten years and want to serve under private Management, with their
own option.
(f) House
Building/Car/Motor Cycle and other advance/Loans.‑‑--The deduction on account of the above will continue till
liquidation. In case of transfer of pensionary benefits such deductions will be
made in lumpsum.
(g)
Building/Assets etc.‑‑The institutions
will continuously operate on the same site and land/Building shall be
used/altered for no other purpose except education.
The old
owner/management agree in writing to forego all claims of all kinds against the
Government.
3. STUDENT
AFFAIRS
Fee.‑‑The Management of the privatized institutions shall not levy any
extra tuition fees on students unless approved by the Government.
Syllabus.‑‑Syllabi of all such privatized educational institutions will be in
accordance with the National Education Policy as adopted by the Government from
time to time.
The process of
Islamization and the emphasis on Islamic Principles will not be affected in any
manner. The new management will continue to follow the curricula prescribed by
the Federal Government which is binding on all institutions in the country.
